You move, monsters move.
You stop, they stop too.

Everyone takes turns in a
Mystery Dungeon. Monsters act
only when you do, so there is
no need to rush. Stop and plan
your next move!

You can heal without an Herb!
Walking restores HP!

Fighting is not your only
option.
Flee monsters when needed.
Walk until HP is restored,
then strike back!

Throw Herbs and staves!
Even spent staves work!

Some Herbs and staves affect
monsters when thrown at them.
A staff with 0 charges still
works when it is thrown.
What a useful trick!

Equip Bracelets right away!
Repair cracks quickly too!

A Bracelet works only while
equipped. Traps or blows may
crack it. If that happens, ask
a blacksmith to repair it as
soon as you can!

Do not search forever!
The wind can end your trip!

Stay on one floor too long.
A strong wind may send you
back to town. Know your goal,
and use your time wisely!

Items reveal hidden traps!
Swinging a weapon can too!

Certain items reveal traps.
Without one, swing a weapon
to check the space ahead.
To trigger a trap yourself,
bounce an item off a wall and
have it land on the trap!

Blessings power items up!
Curses power items down!

A blessing draws out an item's
power, strengthening gear or
improving its effect. A curse
does the opposite: equipment
may become stuck, and some
items cannot be used!

Pots carry extra items!

You can store items in a Pot,
but usually must break it to
retrieve them. A Preservation
Pot is different: you may move
items in and out without ever
breaking it!

Beware of sleeping foes!
Sneak by while they slumber!

Even dangerous monsters may
be asleep. Keep your distance
and quietly slip past them.
Some wake when you enter or
leave a room, so stay alert!

Move diagonally to save food!
Monsters cannot catch you!

Diagonal movement is vital.
It helps you flee safely and
avoid wasted steps. That also
conserves Fullness. Master it
in Wanderer's Secrets!

Gear numbers show strength!

Higher numbers mean stronger
gear. For example, <2D>3 is
stronger than <26>1. Every
weapon and shield has a limit,
so keep that in mind!

Pots and staves have limits!

A Pot's number shows capacity.
A staff's number is charges.
A Pot marked 3 holds three
items. A staff marked 3 can
be used three times.

Combine compatible gear!

Some gear pairs work well.
Equip a Cudgel with a Wood
Shield, for example, and both
become <2D>3. Other useful
combinations exist too!

Unknown items are a mystery.
Try them to learn the effect!

Use an Identifier Scroll to
learn its name and effect.
You can also test it and judge
the result. Once you know its
effect, name the item!

Name unknown items easily!

Select an unidentified item
and choose Name, then Fill In.
A list of known item names
will appear for you to choose
from.

There are ten grades!
Your grade proves your skill!

Wanderer Grade is on the Game
Menu. It rates your skill on
ten levels, based on dungeon
clear conditions you fulfilled.
